# Pure BIT - Beijing Institute of Technology Research Portal

> A comprehensive research and faculty directory for Beijing Institute of Technology showcasing cutting-edge work across aerospace, automation, materials science, and advanced engineering disciplines.

Pure BIT is the institutional research repository and faculty portal for Beijing Institute of Technology, featuring detailed profiles of researchers and their specializations across multiple engineering and scientific domains. The platform aggregates research interests, publications, and academic credentials from faculty members across the university's schools and institutes.

## Key Topics

- Beijing Institute of Technology
- Aerospace Engineering
- Mechatronical Engineering
- School of Automation
- Material Science
- Metal-Organic Frameworks
- Unmanned Systems
- Computer Vision
- Faculty Profiles
- Research Publications
- Composite Materials
- Energy Harvesting
- Explosion Mechanics
- Autonomous Systems
- Control Engineering

## Aerospace & Mechanical Engineering Faculty

- [Lina Yang - Thermoelectric Materials & Nanomaterials](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/lina-yang): Aerospace engineering researcher specializing in thermoelectric materials and nanomaterials at BIT.
- [Huan Zhang - Space Manipulators & Multibody Dynamics](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/huan-zhang): Assistant professor focusing on aerospace engineering, space manipulators, and multibody dynamics.
- [Guangyan Liu - Composite Materials & Failure Analysis](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/guangyan-liu): Aerospace engineering researcher investigating composite materials and failure analysis.
- [Yuanyuan He - Aircraft Design & Bionic MAVs](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/yuanyuan-he): Associate professor in aerospace engineering researching aircraft design and bionic micro-aerial vehicles.
- [Jimin Han - Energetic Materials & Metal-Organic Frameworks](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/jimin-han): Faculty in mechatronical engineering researching energetic materials and metal-organic frameworks.

## Automation, Control & Unmanned Systems

- [Baokui Li - Control Engineering & Unmanned Systems](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/baokui-li): Associate professor in control engineering and unmanned systems at School of Automation.
- [Zhiguo Zhou - Point Cloud Detection & Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/zhiguo-zhou): Researcher specializing in point cloud detection, deep reinforcement learning, and autonomous systems.
- [Zhiqiang Zhou - Navigation Control & Pattern Recognition](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/zhiqiang-zhou): Faculty in automation engineering researching navigation control and pattern recognition.

## Materials Science & Chemistry

- [Yu Li - Battery Materials & Lithium-Ion Cathodes](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/yu-li): Researcher specializing in battery materials, lithium-ion cathodes, and electrochemistry.
- [Meng Yu - Inorganic Chemistry & MRI Contrast Agents](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/meng-yu): Researcher in inorganic chemistry, metal-organic frameworks, and MRI contrast agents.
- [Li Sui - Fuze Technology & Energy Harvesting](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/li-sui): Associate professor specializing in fuze technology, piezoelectric systems, and energy harvesting.

## Explosives, Mechanics & Protection Engineering

- [Tianbao Ma - Explosion Mechanics & Shaped Charge](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/tianbao-ma): Faculty researching explosion mechanics, numerical simulation, and shaped charge technology.
- [Junbo Yan - Explosion Damage Protection & Blast Loading](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/junbo-yan): Assistant professor specializing in explosion damage protection and blast loading analysis.

## Electronics, Optics & Communications

- [Yang Cheng - Optics, Photonics & Imaging Systems](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/yang-cheng): Researcher in optics and photonics, imaging systems, and liquid lens technology.
- [Yongfeng Ma - Terahertz Technology & Antenna Systems](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/yongfeng-ma): Researcher specializing in terahertz technology, millimeter-waves, and antenna systems.
- [Jihua Lu - Integrated Circuits & Sensing Systems](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/jihua-lu): Associate professor specializing in integrated circuits, sensing systems, and signal processing.

## Mathematics & Acoustics

- [Qianyun Miao - Partial Differential Equations & Variational Methods](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/qianyun-miao): Faculty in mathematics specializing in partial differential equations and variational methods.
- [Feng Li - Acoustic Metamaterials & Phonon Crystals](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/feng-li-2): Faculty researching acoustic metamaterials, topological acoustics, and phonon crystals.

## Management & Business Education

- [Xin Li - MBA & Bilingual Education Programs](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/xin-li-3): Faculty from School of Management teaching MBA and bilingual education programs.
- [Jiancai Wang - Supply Chain Management & Operations](https://pure.bit.edu.cn/en/persons/jiancai-wang): Faculty researching supply chain management and operations at School of Management.
